sloka: यदि तद्विहतं कार्यं मम प्रज्ञाविपर्ययात् ।इहैव प्राणसंन्यासो ममापि ह्यद्य रोचते ।। 5.55.13 ।।।।
transliteration: yadi tadvihataṁ kāryaṁ mama prajñāviparyayāt ।ihaiva prāṇasaṁnyāso mamāpi hyadya rocate ।। 5.55.13 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Shall I end my life by jumping into fire just now, or else into the mouth of submarine fire? Should I offer my body to the living creatures of the ocean as their food?
